meta.title: Where to Stay in Hoi An: Best Areas Near Ancient Town (2025 Guide!)
meta.description:
Hoi An is one of Vietnam's most popular destinations. In this video, I'm going to share the best areas to stay near Hoi An's Old Town. 

First-time visitors to Hoi An and travelers looking for convenience - I recommend staying near the Old Town. Since it's a UNESCO Heritage Site, there are no hotels in this protected zone but there are many hotels near the town, within 10-minutes walking distance. There are many shops, restaurants, cafes, and of course the historical ancient houses and buildings in this town. This area is a no car-zone so there are only scooters and bicycles allowed which makes it pedestrian friendly.
